liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The transition from China Cat Sunflower to I Know You Rider was hot [6]

## The recordings

- **gd70-11-11.aud.cotsman.17081.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 33 songs; 176 min; rated 3.45/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording has poor sound quality, though the listener eventually favored the performance; The audio quality is poor, but the performance itself is considered very good; The sound quality is rough, but the show is valued as a historic piece [1][5][6][8][11][12]
- **gd70-11-11.aud.sirmick.31154.sbeok.flacf**: audience recording; 33 songs; 175 min; rated 2.67/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: The reviewer describes the recording as the worst they have ever heard; The sound during John's Other is described as bloomin' awful at times; The recording of Ode To Billie Dean sounds pretty good [9][14][15]
- **gd1970-11-11.179257.sbd.cassidy.minches.miller.t.flac1648**: soundboard; 18 songs; 154 min [3]
- **gd1970-11-11.179254.sbd.cassidy.minches.miller.t.flac2496**: soundboard; 18 songs; 154 min [4]

## Around the show

- A last-minute makeup show drew a crowd filling only a quarter of the venue [5]
- The Loews 46th Street Theatre, a former movie house, held about 2,500 people [7]
- The hall, renamed Banana Fish Garden, hosted tapings for the ABC Rock Concert show [7]
- The show is confirmed to feature Jorma Kaukonen among the guests [10]
- The taper announced the title of the song during the performance of Come Back Baby [14]
- John's Other was performed with Jorma, Jack, and Papa John Creech [3]
- The Brooklyn audience appeared more intense than audiences at other shows the band played [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-11-11.aud.cotsman.17081.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Chuck Kiefe and JCotsman; source: Audience: Unknown Mics [1]. Also: Severe pitch problems, crackles, pops, and channel flips were corrected during transfer [1]
- **gd70-11-11.aud.sirmick.31154.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by SIRMick; source: Audience: Unknown Mics (remaster) [2]. Also: The setlist indicates Jorma Kaukonen, Jack Casady, and Papa John Creach joined for songs [2]
- **gd1970-11-11.179257.sbd.cassidy.minches.miller.t.flac1648**: taped by Peter S. Kimble; transferred by Transferred by David Minches Mastered by Charlie Miller  September 17, 2026; source: SBD (mono) > Master Reel (3.75ips) [3]. Also: Thanks to Martin Cassidy for the tapes, with distortion cleaned up where possible [3]
- **gd1970-11-11.179254.sbd.cassidy.minches.miller.t.flac2496**: taped by Peter S. Kimble; transferred by Transferred by David Minches Mastered by Charlie Miller  September 17, 2026; source: SBD (mono) > Master Reel (3.75ips) [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead 46th Street Rock Palace, Brooklyn, Poster](https://www.dead.net/archives/1970/artwork/46th-street-rock-palace-brooklyn-poster) [18]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead 46th Street Rock Palace - November 11, 1970](https://www.dead.net/show/november-11-1970) [19]
